tools.name: search_guidelines
tools.description:
Look a rule up in the UMR guidelines (umr4nlp/umr-guidelines, guidelines.md).

keywords: terms to look for, e.g. "aspect", "modal strength", "have-rel-role-92", ":quant",
"reentrancy". Passages with more of the keywords come first, then those whose heading has
them, then those that mention them most.
max_results: how many passages to return (at most 10).

Returns {"sections": [{"heading": the passage's place in the guidelines ("Part 3. ... > Part
3-3-1. Aspect"), "text": the passage (a section, or a part of a long one)}], "found": how
many passages matched}.

tools.name: propbank_lookup
tools.description:
Look up a lemma and every alternate of it in PropBank (at most 20 per call).

language is "en" or "zh". Returns Markdown: per lemma, every roleset with its roles and all
its examples (the sentence, then each argument; traces such as *T*-1 are PropBank's own),
or "not in PropBank". Lemmas over the limit are not looked up: the last line names them
(call again with them). There is no PropBank for another language (Uzbek): nothing.

tools.name: search_annotations
tools.description:
Find how a case is annotated: gold UMR annotations of whole sentences.

language: "zh" (Chinese) or "en" (English).
keywords: words or pieces to look for, matched anywhere in a sentence or its annotation:
words of the text (e.g. "发生", "wanted to"), concepts ("have-org-role-91", "identity-91"),
roles (":ARG1-of", ":manner"), attribute values (":aspect state"). Sentences with more of the
keywords come first.
max_results: how many gold sentences to return (at most 10).

Returns {"gold": [{"doc", "sentence_number", "sentence", "annotation"}], where annotation is
the sentence's whole annotation (words, sentence-level graph, alignment, document-level
annotation); "found": how many gold sentences matched in all}.

## 带

### 带-01

- ARG0: theme
- ARG1: features that theme possesses

Example 1: *OP* *T*-4 带 画中画 功能 的 数字 彩色 电视机
- ARG0: *T*-4
- ARG1: 画中画 功能
- rel: 带

### 带-02

- ARG0: agent
- ARG1: thing brought
- ARG2: beneficiary
- ARG3: destination

Example 1: 近年 来 ， 中国 各 地 一 批 知名 企业 带 着 名牌 产品 、 资金 和 技术
- ARG0: 中国 各 地 一 批 知名 企业
- ARG1: 名牌 产品 、 资金 和 技术
- ARGM-TMP: 近年 来
- rel: 带

### 带-03

- ARG0: agent
- ARG1: theme
- ARG2: thing arg0 leads arg1 to do

Example 1: *OP* *T*-2 现任 行政 暨 公职 司 人力 资源 厅 聘任 及 甄选 处 处长 谭惠珠 带 著 访客 *PRO* 参观 公职 司

- ARG1: 访客
- ARG2: *PRO* 参观 公职 司
- rel: 带

Example 2: 夫妻 带 三 个 小孩
- ARG0: 夫妻
- ARG1: 三 个 小孩
- rel: 带

### 带-04

- ARG0: entity described
- ARG1: thing arg0 is vague about

Example 1: 不过 ， 陈水扁 虽然 主张 *PRO* 要 立法 保障 教育 经费 ， 但 却 不 像 许信良 明确 说 *pro* 要 保障 到 国民 生产 毛额 的 百分之六 ， 而 是 模糊 带 过
- ARG0: 陈水扁

- ARGM-DIS: 而
- ARGM-ADV: 不过
- rel: 带

### 带-05

- ARG0: person described
- ARG1: thing arg0 wears

Example 1: 她 应该 是 个 *OP* *T*-1 盛装 打扮 的 贵妇 ， 梳 著 发髻 ， 带 著 项圈
- ARG0: 她
- ARG1: 项圈
- rel: 带

### 带-06

- ARG0: agent
- ARG1: class arg0 teaches

Example 1: *OP* *T*-1 第二 年 带 高雄 成功 启智 学校 戏剧 课 的 卓明
- ARG0: *T*-1
- ARG1: 高雄 成功 启智 学校 戏剧 课
- ARGM-TMP: 第二 年
- rel: 带

## 到来

### 到来-01

Example 1: “ 这 个 时刻 已经 到来 ”
- ARG0: 这 个 时刻
- ARGM-ADV: 已经

content.text:
I read the sentence as an advertising line: "As the Year of the Dragon is about to arrive, why not hurry and bring 'Fuyun' home!"

# ::snt 12
# sentence level graph:
(s12b / 带-02
    :ARG0 (s12p / person
        :refer-person 2nd)
    :ARG1 (s12f / product
        :name (s12n / name
            :op1 "福韵"))
    :ARG3 (s12h / 回家)
    :manner (s12g / 赶快)
    :mod (s12h2 / 还)
    :temporal (s12s / 时
        :temporal-of (s12d / 到来-01
            :ARG0 (s12l / 龙年)
            :mod (s12k / 快)
            :aspect performance))
    :mode imperative
    :modal-strength partial-affirmative
    :aspect performance)

Choices I made that are open to question:
- **还不赶快 ("why not hurry")**: I read this as a rhetorical push to act, not a real negation. So the main verb has `:mode imperative`, `:modal-strength partial-affirmative` and no `:polarity -`. The gold example 赶快写信告诉我 handles a command the same way.
- **赶快**: it is not in PropBank, so it is a plain `:manner` modifier and not an event.
- **带 ("bring")**: I chose sense `带-02`, whose `:ARG3` is the destination. The text splits 回家 off as its own word, so I used it as the destination concept rather than making it a second event (`回家-01`). That is the least certain part of the graph.
- **在…之时 ("when…")**: built as `时 :temporal-of 到来-01`, following a gold example with 之时.
- **快要 ("about to")**: shown as `:mod 快`. I gave 到来 the aspect `performance`; a finer value such as `inceptive` might fit better.
- **Other nodes**: I typed 福韵 as a `product` named entity. The unstated addressee is a 2nd-person `person` node with no word in the sentence.
